Subtracting 259 days from 1480-12-07:  
1480 is a leap year (divisible by 4, pre-Gregorian but using Gregorian rules).  
From 1480-12-07 back 7 days → 1480-11-30.  
Back 30 more days → 1480-10-31.  
Remaining 259 − 37 = 222 days earlier.  
From 1480-10-31: October has 31 days, so back 31 days → 1480-09-30.  
Remaining 222 − 31 = 191 days earlier.  
September (30 days) → 1480-08-31, remaining 191 − 30 = 161 days earlier.  
August (31 days) → 1480-07-31, remaining 161 − 31 = 130 days earlier.  
July (31 days) → 1480-06-30, remaining 130 − 31 = 99 days earlier.  
June (30 days) → 1480-05-31, remaining 99 − 30 = 69 days earlier.  
May (31 days) → 1480-04-30, remaining 69 − 31 = 38 days earlier.  
April (30 days) → 1480-03-31, remaining 38 − 30 = 8 days earlier.  
Back 8 more days from 1480-03-31 → 1480-03-23.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1480-03-23
